lines.description: Voice over services, Altra BC: one :30 spot plus a :15 and a :06 cutdown from the same recording. 12-month worldwide license, all media excluding broadcast, recording exclusive (terms below), credit card payment option

notes: License: 12 months from first publication, worldwide, all media excluding broadcast (OOH, industrial, internal, web and social paid and organic, OTT and pre-roll). The recording is exclusive to Altra / VF for the term; talent is non-exclusive.

Any additional versions or cutdowns beyond the :30, :15 and :06 are quoted separately. The recordings may not be used for AI, synthetic voice or voice-model training. Use beyond 12 months by renewal agreement.
